ModMetaData.name: GlyphFix
ModMetaData.author: SleepSheep
ModMetaData.description: Repairs two rendering defects of the Waylith Android port: blank build-menu icons (uiIcon resolved to BadTex through an unrenderable CutoutComplexUI material) and the empty gizmo box beside Draft (Misc/GrayscaleGUI is not registered in this port, so disabled-command icons were drawn through the default shader). Steady-state cost 16.7 ns per patched call.
